name: memshield-bench

memshield-bench
	

The first labeled benchmark dataset for AI agent memory poisoning detection.
1,178 entries (856 clean, 322 poisoned) across 10 attack types, 7 domains, and 3 difficulty levels. Clean background text drawn from the AgentPoison (NeurIPS 2024) knowledge bases; poisoned entries authored for this dataset inspired by AgentPoison, MemoryGraft, and Microsoft advisory threat models.
